title: Generic WebGlRunLib still contains domain-shaped action kind ResourceTransferVisual
evidence: src/CanDoItAll.Components.WebGlRunLib/Actions/WebGlRunActionKinds.cs exposes ResourceTransferVisual in generic action kinds.
risk: Generic run layer remains subtly shaped by economy examples; production-line or unrelated visual domains may inherit economy-specific vocabulary.
fix: Replace with generic ValueFlowVisual/LinkFlowVisual/DirectedFlowVisual or move the domain action behind a domain driver in Economy bridge.

title: Forbidden domain terms moved to configurable boundary options, but enforcement must be CI-backed
evidence: WebGlRunGenericBoundaryOptions accepts forbidden terms and EconomyWebGlMappingBoundary supplies economy-specific list.
risk: Good architectural move, but future domain-specific terms can re-enter generic packages unless scan is stable and blocks PRs.
fix: Add CI/domain-leakage scan that checks WebGlLib/WebGlRunLib source, tests, public constants, samples, and package metadata; domain lists live in driver packages.

title: Pause ordering is improved through stop coordinator, but must be proven by first-stop observable UX gate
evidence: StopCoordinator performs immediate runtime stop before cancel/drain/final stop; RunPlayback uses StopAsync.
risk: User-observed pause bug can regress if browser proof only checks final idle, not immediate visible stop latency and stale callback suppression.
fix: Add Playwright proof that captures state immediately after Pause and after drain, asserts no active motions/stages, stable frame, no stale UI rewrite.

title: Observer proof must use actual browser-exported run/scene state, not self-comparison or derived fallback positions
evidence: RunPlayback builds observer snapshot from latest diagnostics/proof snapshot, with fallback expected final positions if ObjectPositions are absent.
risk: Browser proof can pass even if browser state is incomplete or not exactly equal to the headless run document.
fix: Require runtime-exported scene/document hash and object positions from browser; no fallback positions in proof; mismatch = observer failure only.

title: Readiness flags must be artifact-derived, not caller asserted
evidence: Readiness options still expose BrowserRuntimeExercised, UIExercised, OracleProofExercised booleans.
risk: A caller could mark evidence as exercised without supplying verifiable artifacts, inflating confidence/research-ready status.
fix: Introduce EvidenceBundle inputs with hashes/citations; booleans become computed outputs only.

title: multi-goods-elite exists but should be hardened as a genericity canary, not only a demo fixture
evidence: Runtime catalog contains multi-goods-elite with grain/tools/credit/equity-share, trade, contribution, claim, fee, obligation events.
risk: Scenario may exercise added event kinds but still hide gaps in exchange clearing, investment return, claim accounting, elite concentration metrics, and visualization genericity.
fix: Promote it to canary suite with external oracle, metamorphic checks, factor matrix, scenario docs, and generic visual flow driver.

title: Economy bridge contains mapping logic but generic extension/driver boundary is not explicit enough
evidence: EconomyWebGlBridge maps EconomyVisualActionKind to WebGlRunActionKinds and supplies boundary terms.
risk: Future domains may copy economy mapping instead of implementing clean drivers, causing generic layer drift.
fix: Define a formal visual/run domain driver pattern: driver-owned action vocabulary, mapping, validation, boundary terms, oracle tests.

title: Design matrix factor materialization improved but needs factor binding coverage for third scenario
evidence: Harness materializes effective source and supports seed, event magnitude, store quantity, scenario metadata, behavior profile.
risk: Elite/exchange experiments need factor bindings for capacities, policy parameters, event inclusion, returns, fees, and relationship strength.
fix: Add binding registry and no-effect hard fail for every factor type used by multi-goods-elite.

title: Historic proof transcripts include zero-length artifacts; v10 must enforce non-empty meaningful proof
evidence: Earlier bundle proofs had empty transcript files in compare output.
risk: Bundle can appear completed even when critical commands did not run or output was lost.
fix: Proof validator must fail zero-byte transcripts except explicitly allowlisted binary screenshots and intentional placeholder files.
